question: Who coined the name “Bermuda Triangle”, and when?
answer: In 1964, journalist Edward Van Winkle Jones kept claiming that strange things happened in the area, all from one mysterious cause. That year another newspaper, citing Jones, introduced the name "Bermuda Triangle", and the legend was born. The name was born in print, not out at sea.
move: The “Bermuda Triangle” was born in print in 1964, not out at sea.
